disclosure:
BUYBACK / NET-SHARE-ISSUANCE FAMILY — READ BEFORE TRUSTING ANY NUMBER.
Pre-declared family size 14 definitions (3 lookbacks x 2 holds x 2 portfolio modes = 12, plus 2 winsorized robustness variants at the 504-day lookback), fixed before the run and used as the DSR's n_trials denominator in this family's own, never-pooled screening call.
Universe: 691 point-in-time S&P 500 members over the window, of which 94 resolved no price data and 0 no usable share-count history. Eligibility is decided per formation date by sp500_membership_history.was_member, never by today's constituent list.
DATA CORRECTION APPLIED (defect 1, splits): 132 priced ticker(s) had at least one split inside the window and 25858 share-count observation(s) were restated onto a single basis by cross_sectional_ivol.split_adjust_share_counts. WITHOUT this, a reverse-splitter (GE, 1-for-8 on 2021-08-02) reads as an ~87% buyback and lands in the top long decile, and a forward-splitter (ANET, 4-for-1 on 2021-11-18) reads as ~300% dilution and lands in the bottom short decile — both entirely fictional.
DATA COARSENESS (defect 2, stepwise filings): the median share count in the replayed panel was 7 calendar days old (after the 45-day reporting lag). The panel is forward-filled as a STEP function and never interpolated; a count is refused outright once carried more than 400 days, so a dead series cannot masquerade as a confident 0.00% issuance reading.
UNINFORMATIVE WINDOWS REFUSED (defect 2): share of otherwise-usable names whose two window endpoints were the identical filed count — no new share count filed anywhere inside the window, so an exact 0.00% would have been fabricated rather than observed — 126d lookback 8.1%, 252d lookback 2.0%, 504d lookback 0.2%. These are refused (NaN, unranked), never ranked as zeros.
COSTS: 5.0bp one-way per unit of gross notional TRADED (a full long_short book is gross 2.0, so ~10bp to establish from flat and 10bp x the fraction of book replaced per reformation), and 0.0bps/yr per unit of gross notional HELD. That financing zero is a DISCLOSURE, not an estimate: this project has no sourced US equity borrow rate, so any positive short-leg contribution below is optimistic by an unmeasured amount — the same known gap every equity family in this project carries.

deflated_sharpe.interpretation: This is 1 of N=14 similar configurations run against this ticker/strategy. Adjusting for that search — and for this run's own sample size (2173 days), skew, and kurtosis — there is an estimated 60% probability that this strategy's true long-run Sharpe ratio exceeds 0.33, the Sharpe you'd expect from the best of 14 equally-skilled, zero-edge trials by chance alone. (Before accounting for the number of trials searched, PSR-vs-zero was 89%.) This is not a p-value or a guarantee — it is the model's best point estimate of the strategy's true statistical edge, not a certainty.
